summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] form in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool, with the required docstring warnings; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py). Tests were not run and black was not run; formatting was checked by hand. Nothing was committed.
